items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: I think you can actually find some of that on some old Tilly and Morton records.

ctx.x: That's why I asked you. You're just for doing it, you know, but I wanted to know who was the first person. Well, I don't have to do that.
Yeah. I think, I think, I think you can actually find some of that on some old Tilly and Morton records. I'm not positive. I've never heard it on the old records.
That started, uh, doing the Bebop. I think it really started, uh, just before the Bebop era.
